Previously, when desktop Claude needed to reconnect to an MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools) server, it misdirected you to check web settings or run the `/mcp` command, even though neither option existed in that environment; this guidance has now been corrected. ⟦Just as pairing an environmental sensor with smart home appliances previously dropped the entire connection when optional parameters were missing while prompting users toward nonexistent buttons, omitting non-core values now maintains normal operation while offering accurate indicator light guidance.⟧ Meanwhile, when an external server negotiates protocol version 2026-07-28 without providing optional fields such as `resultType`, `ttlMs`, or `cacheScope`, the tool list no longer goes blank, and tool calls no longer fail completely.

items.original:
Fixed Claude in the desktop app pointing you to claude.ai settings or `/mcp` to authorize or reconnect an MCP server where that option isn't available
Fixed MCP servers showing no tools, or every tool call failing, when the server negotiates protocol version 2026-07-28 but omits `resultType`, `ttlMs` or `cacheScope`

title.zh-TW: 分叉子代理預設開啟，背景執行規則跨介面對齊
title.en: Forked subagents enabled by default, background execution rules aligned across interfaces

body.zh-TW: 在桌面應用程式、VS Code 或是透過程式呼叫 Claude 時，分頭處理多項任務的規則現在與終端機統一。分叉子代理（subagent_type: "fork"）在 `claude -p`、Agent SDK、桌面版與 VS Code 改為預設開啟，若要關閉可設 `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0`，`claude mcp serve` 則不提供。桌面版與 VS Code 主對話的子代理現在固定在背景執行，不再由模型決定；子代理發起的代理呼叫則預設在前景執行。檢視畫面中捲動長清單或摺疊分組後內容反白空行的問題已經修復，底部的 `← for agents` 提示文字也會在工作階段開啟 10 秒後自動隱藏，僅保留等待處理的代理數量計數。
body.en: When using Claude in the desktop app, VS Code, or programmatically, rules for handling multiple tasks in parallel are now unified with the terminal. Forked subagents (`subagent_type: "fork"`) are now enabled by default in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, desktop, and VS Code; to disable them, set `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0`, while `claude mcp serve` does not offer them. Subagents in main conversations on desktop and VS Code now always run in the background rather than being decided by the model, whereas agent calls initiated by subagents run in the foreground by default. An issue in the viewer where scrolling long lists or collapsing groups resulted in highlighted blank lines has been fixed, and the bottom `← for agents` hint text now automatically hides 10 seconds after a session opens, leaving only a count of pending agents.

items.original:
Fixed rows in the agents view staying blank after moving down a long list or folding a section
Changed fork subagents (`subagent_type: "fork"`) to be on by default in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code, as they already are in the terminal; `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` turns them off, and `claude mcp serve` never offers them
Changed the desktop app and VS Code to always run the main conversation's subagents in the background, as the terminal does, rather than let Claude choose; a subagent's own Agent calls in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code now run in the foreground by default
Changed the `← for agents` footer hint to hide 10 seconds after a session opens; the count of agents waiting on you still shows

title.zh-TW: 第三方雲端無頭模式權限預設為 default，切換通道不再報錯
title.en: Third-party cloud headless mode permissions default to default, switching providers no longer errors

body.zh-TW: 平時在企業雲端平台透過指令或程式庫呼叫 Claude 時，中途切換供應商通道不再卡關。以前在工作階段進行到一半時切換至 Vertex AI 或 Bedrock，請求容易因輸入參數不符（diagnostics: Extra inputs are not permitted）而失敗，這項相容性問題現已修復。在第三方供應商上，若未指定權限模式，且關閉遙測或屬於全新安裝，`claude -p` 與 Agent SDK 工作階段會以 `default` 啟動，若要維持自動授權需明確加上 `--permission-mode auto`。從其他資料夾重新開啟背景工作階段若缺少模型閘道，系統現在會具體說明無法連線的原因，不再含糊顯示未登入。
body.en: When calling Claude on enterprise cloud platforms via the CLI or SDKs, switching provider channels midway through a session will no longer stall. Previously, switching to Vertex AI or Bedrock in the middle of a session frequently failed due to mismatched input parameters (diagnostics: Extra inputs are not permitted); this compatibility issue is now resolved. On third-party providers, if no permission mode is specified and telemetry is disabled or the setup is a fresh install, `claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions will start with `default`, requiring an explicit `--permission-mode auto` to maintain automatic approvals. When reopening background sessions from other folders that lack a model gateway, the system now specifically explains why the connection failed instead of vaguely reporting that you are not logged in.

items.original:
Fixed requests failing with "diagnostics: Extra inputs are not permitted" after switching to Vertex or Bedrock mid-session
Improved the message when a background session reopened from another folder has no LLM gateway: it now says why, instead of "Not logged in"
Changed `claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions with no permission mode to start in `default` mode on third-party providers, with telemetry off or on a fresh install; `--permission-mode auto` keeps auto

title.zh-TW: 提示詞與代理掛鉤加入並行上限，同事件最多執行 12 個
title.en: Concurrency limits added for prompt and agent hooks, executing at most 12 per event

body.zh-TW: 當你的自動化工作流替同一事件設定了許多自訂攔截指令時，可以留意哪些正在執行、哪些仍在等待。提示詞與代理掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）現在有了並行上限：同一事件最多同時執行 12 個，其餘掛鉤等待輪到自己。這個數量是按每個事件計算。⟦洗車場替每批進場車輛安排清洗位置；現在同一批最多有 12 輛同時清洗，其餘車輛先在入口等待，有位置才輪到下一輛。⟧
body.en: When your automation workflow sets up many custom interception commands for the same event, you can keep track of which are currently executing and which are still waiting. Prompt and agent hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) now have a concurrency limit: at most 12 can run concurrently for the same event, with remaining hooks waiting their turn. This limit is calculated on a per-event basis. ⟦A car wash arranges cleaning bays for incoming batches of vehicles: at most 12 cars can now be washed simultaneously in the same batch, while remaining vehicles wait at the entrance until a bay clears for the next one in line.⟧

items.original: Changed prompt and agent hooks so that at most 12 of one event run at a time; the rest wait their turn

title.zh-TW: Windows 外接磁碟寫入不再遭拒，Git 孤立檔案與抓取修復
title.en: Windows external drive writes no longer rejected, Git orphaned files and fetch fixed

body.zh-TW: 當你在不同作業系統或特殊磁碟格式下編寫專案時，現在檔案修改與版本控制會順暢許多。在 Windows 環境中，若專案位於 exFAT 或 FAT32 格式的磁碟槽上，包含加上 `--plugin-dir` 參數啟動的工作階段，以前每次寫入檔案都會遭到系統拒絕或頻繁彈出確認，現在這項權限誤判已經修好。在 Git 2.56 或更新版本中，若目錄殘留了指向不存在路徑的孤立 `.git` 檔案，工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）隔離機制不再拒絕建立或復原工作樹。對於自架執行器（self-hosted runner），若重複使用 reftable 格式的簽出目錄，`git fetch` 抓取資料時不再因物件錯誤而中斷。⟦像在特殊規格的檔案夾內整理工程圖紙，以前遇到活頁扣環不同或殘留廢棄標籤便整本拒收，現在能順暢辨識夾層並落實歸檔。⟧
body.en: When working on projects across different operating systems or specialized disk formats, file modifications and version control will now run much more smoothly. On Windows, if a project is located on an exFAT or FAT32 partition—including sessions started with the `--plugin-dir` flag—file writes that were previously rejected by the system or triggered frequent confirmation prompts have had their permission misjudgments fixed. In Git 2.56 or newer, if a directory retains an orphaned `.git` file pointing to a nonexistent path, the worktree (a Git feature for maintaining multiple copies of the same project in parallel) isolation mechanism no longer refuses to create or restore worktrees. For self-hosted runners that reuse checkout directories formatted with reftable, running `git fetch` to retrieve data will no longer fail due to object errors. ⟦Like filing engineering blueprints into a nonstandard binder that previously rejected entire folders over mismatched loose-leaf rings or leftover scrap labels, the system now cleanly recognizes divider pockets and properly stores documents.⟧

items.original:
Fixed worktree isolation refusing to create or resume worktrees under git 2.56 or later when a stray `.git` file points at a directory that doesn't exist
Self-hosted runner: Fixed git fetches failing with "bad object refs/heads" in sessions that reuse a checkout stored in git's reftable format
Windows: Fixed every file write being refused or asked about for projects on exFAT or FAT32 drives, including in sessions started with `--plugin-dir`

title.zh-TW: 終端機超連結折行完整可點，表情符號不再破壞表格排版
title.en: Wrapped terminal hyperlinks are fully clickable, and emojis no longer break table layouts

body.zh-TW: 當你在終端機瀏覽 Claude 輸出的長網址或包含圖示的文字時，現在視覺呈現與點擊體驗都更加俐落。以前包裹在反引號內的超長網址若跨行折行，在支援超連結的終端機裡往往只有第一行可以點擊；現在整段網址已整合成一個完整的點擊連結。連結起點落在表情符號（emoji）內時，折行寬度會多算一個字元欄位，造成該表情符號在問題預覽中被隱藏，並讓表格變成清單；這些問題已修復。⟦恰如老式鉛字排版機完成了字距微調，以前遇到特殊圖案印章就讓整行表格破版走位，長網址切成兩行也只能掃出半張條碼，現在版面工整對齊且條碼隨點即通。⟧
body.en: When you browse long URLs or text containing icons output by Claude in the terminal, visual presentation and click experiences are now much cleaner. Previously, when an extra-long URL wrapped in backticks wrapped across lines, only the first line was clickable in terminals that support hyperlinks. Now, the entire URL is consolidated into a single clickable link. When a link started inside an emoji, the wrap width counted an extra character cell, causing that emoji to be hidden in question previews and turning tables into lists. These issues are now fixed. ⟦A vintage printing press receives a fine kerning tune-up: previously, hitting a special emblem stamp misaligned an entire table row and splitting a long address across two lines left only half a barcode readable, whereas now the layout stays neatly aligned and barcodes scan on contact.⟧

items.original:
Fixed URLs written in backticks being clickable only on their first row when they wrap; the whole URL is now one link in terminals that support hyperlinks
Fixed an emoji that a link starts inside wrapping one column too wide, which hid it in question previews and turned tables into lists

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段費用累計不歸零，點數方案跳過額外建議
title.en: Cloud session costs no longer reset during accumulation, and credit plans skip extra suggestions

body.zh-TW: 當你關注帳戶的額度消耗或在雲端持續進行專案時，現在用量與成本統計變得更加精準。如果你的訂閱方案針對特定模型僅能以額外點數計費，Claude 在回覆該次提問並扣除點數後，會自動跳過後續的提示建議，避免在背景悄悄消耗你的用量點數。同時，雲端工作階段在新的行程中恢復時，先前累積的費用與用量不再歸零。⟦正如智慧停車場的計費閘門，以前系統重開機就會把前段停車時數歸零重算，遇到以時計費的特殊車位還會自動推銷非必要服務，現在費用結算分文不漏且消費透明清楚。⟧
body.en: When you monitor account quota consumption or continue projects in the cloud, usage and cost tracking are now more precise. If your subscription plan charges for specific models solely via extra credits, Claude automatically skips follow-up prompt suggestions after answering the query and deducting credits, preventing silent credit consumption in the background. Meanwhile, when a cloud session resumes in a new process, previously accumulated costs and usage no longer reset to zero. ⟦An automated parking garage gate upgrades its billing software: previously, rebooting the system wiped earlier parking hours back to zero and hourly premium spots automatically pushed unneeded add-ons, whereas now billing tracks every cent without omission and spending remains crystal clear.⟧

items.original:
Fixed prompt suggestions spending usage credits on models your plan pays for only with credits: they are now skipped after a reply billed to credits
Fixed a cloud session's cost and usage restarting from zero after the session resumed in a new process

title.zh-TW: 讀取工具設下圖片大小上限，超過 128 MB 直接拒載
title.en: Read tool sets image size limit, directly rejecting sources over 128 MB

body.zh-TW: 當你請 Claude 讀取本機圖片時，來源大小會影響它是否載入。以前讀取工具（Read tool，用來查看檔案內容的工具）會把任何大小的圖片檔，或名稱像圖片的管道、裝置，整份載入記憶體。現在超過 128 MB 的圖片來源會被拒絕載入。
body.en: When you ask Claude to read local images, the source size determines whether it loads. Previously, the Read tool (a utility for inspecting file contents) loaded image files of any size, or pipes and devices named like images, entirely into memory. Now, image sources exceeding 128 MB are rejected from loading.

items.original: Fixed the Read tool loading an image file of any size, or a pipe or device named like an image, entirely into memory; image sources over 128 MB are now refused

title.zh-TW: 成果物發布支援空修改，版本衝突重試邏輯修復
title.en: Artifact publishing supports empty modifications, and version conflict retry logic is fixed

body.zh-TW: 當你讓 Claude 在對話中動態生成或即時修改展示成果物時，發布過程不再因為小意外而中斷。成果物（artifact，獨立生成的展示面板或程式碼檔案）在發布時，若 Claude 傳送了空的修改清單，系統不再判定失敗。同時，若某份成果物在送出更新的過程中已由其他地方產生了更新的版本，遭到退件後 Claude 也不會再以錯誤的方式盲目重試，而是會遵循正確的重試機制更新內容。⟦好比向機關送審修訂藍圖，以前就算只是附上原圖無文字修改也會被拒收，遇到他人搶先登記新版次時還會胡亂重複遞件，現在既能順利接收無修改發布，遇版本衝突時也能按規範重新審查。⟧
body.en: When you have Claude dynamically generate or modify display artifacts in conversation, the publishing flow is no longer interrupted by minor glitches. When publishing an artifact (a standalone display panel or code file), the system no longer fails if Claude transmits an empty list of modifications. Meanwhile, if a newer version of an artifact was already created elsewhere while an update was being submitted, Claude no longer blindly retries in an erroneous manner upon rejection, but follows the proper retry mechanism to update content. ⟦Submitting revised blueprints to a municipal office follows new intake protocols: previously, attaching the original diagram without textual edits triggered an outright rejection, and having someone else register a newer revision first led to frantic, blind resubmissions, but now zero-change submissions are accepted cleanly and version conflicts trigger a proper re-review.⟧

items.original: Fixed artifact publishes sometimes failing when Claude sent an empty list of edits, and Claude retrying an artifact update the wrong way after a newer version of the artifact turned it away

title.zh-TW: 組織停用回饋指令時，提示訊息改為引導至 GitHub
title.en: Prompt message redirects to GitHub when organizations disable the feedback command

body.zh-TW: 當你在公司或企業受管的團隊環境下使用終端機，若想對工具功能提出建言，可以留意回饋指令顯示的提示。當所屬組織的管理政策關閉了 `/feedback` 指令時，畫面上的訊息現在會引導你前往 GitHub issues（用來提交問題的頁面），不再要求你聯絡內部組織管理員。⟦比方公寓大樓的住戶意見箱停用後，公告改貼另一個收件地址；以前公告指向管理室，現在則指向問題回報表單，住戶照著新的指引就知道該往哪裡提交。⟧
body.en: When using the terminal in a corporate or enterprise-managed team environment and looking to share suggestions about tool features, notice the prompt shown by the feedback command. When your organization's administrative policy disables the `/feedback` command, the on-screen message now directs you to GitHub issues (a page used to submit bug reports), instead of asking you to contact an internal organization admin. ⟦When an apartment complex decommissions its resident suggestion box, a replacement notice posts a different forwarding address: whereas the notice once pointed to the building manager's office, it now points directly to an issue submission form so residents know exactly where to deliver feedback.⟧

items.original: Changed the message shown when your organization's policy turns off `/feedback`: it now points to GitHub issues instead of an organization admin

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 離線明確標示，未登入仍可查詢說明
title.en: Remote Control clearly marks offline status, and help remains accessible while logged out

body.zh-TW: 當你透過遠端操控（Remote Control）跨裝置管理工作階段時，現在連線狀態一目了然。如果你的電腦在遠端連線期間離線，介面中的子代理面板不再無止境轉圈等待，而是會明確顯示 Remote Control 連線已中斷。⟦跟操作空拍無人機一樣，以前主機訊號中斷時遙控螢幕只會永久卡在載入圖示，未登入帳號時也看不到指令說明；現在斷線會顯示中斷提示，未登入仍可查看指令說明。⟧同時，若你在尚未登入帳號的狀態下執行 `claude remote-control --help`，系統現在會正常印出完整的指令用法並順利退出，不再異常無反應。
body.en: When managing sessions across devices through Remote Control, connection status is now clear at a glance. If your computer goes offline during a remote connection, the subagent panel in the interface no longer spins indefinitely, but clearly shows that the Remote Control connection has dropped. ⟦Piloting an aerial drone mirrors this communication flow: previously, losing the base station signal left the controller screen stuck forever on a loading spinner, and operating without an account hid all manual instructions, but now disconnections prompt an explicit alert and help documents stay readable without signing in.⟧ Meanwhile, if you run `claude remote-control --help` without being logged in to an account, the system now prints complete command usage and exits cleanly, instead of hanging unresponsive.

items.original:
Fixed `claude remote-control --help` not printing its usage and exiting when not signed in
[Remote Control] Fixed a subagent's pane spinning forever in a Remote Control session after your computer goes offline; it now says Remote Control is disconnected

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 瀏覽器連線狀態校正，未閉合程式碼串流修復
title.en: [VSCode] Browser connection status calibrated, and unclosed code block streaming fixed

body.zh-TW: 當你在 VS Code 編輯器中一邊檢視 Claude 的回答一邊連接周邊工具時，現在畫面顯示與連線狀態都更為精準。以前即使根本無法連線到任何安裝了 Claude 擴充功能的瀏覽器，頂部的 `@browser` 橫幅仍會誤報「Browser connected」；現在連線狀態已校正為真實情況。當 MCP 伺服器的網址中帶有查詢字串（query string）時，從面板進行登入授權不再開啟損壞的驗證網頁。在清單項目中若包含尚未閉合的程式碼區塊，答案串流生成時後續文字一度先顯示為純文字再突兀跳成程式碼的渲染問題，現在也已徹底修正。⟦恰如機房監控面板的指示燈號，以前沒連上外接儀器就謊報連線成功，即時字幕遇到未結束的標籤還會閃爍跳動，現在連線燈號忠實反映現狀，文字串流輸出也流暢無瑕。⟧
body.en: When viewing Claude's responses while connecting peripheral tools inside the VS Code editor, visual display and connection status are now more accurate. Previously, even when unable to connect to any browser with the Claude extension installed, the `@browser` banner at the top mistakenly reported "Browser connected". Now, connection status is calibrated to reflect actual conditions. When an MCP server URL contains a query string, completing login authorization from the panel no longer opens a broken authentication webpage. If a list item contained an unclosed code block, a rendering glitch where subsequent text briefly displayed as plain text before abruptly snapping into code during streamed generation has now been completely fixed. ⟦Status indicators on a server room monitoring panel demonstrate this visual fidelity: previously, the panel falsely signaled a successful link without connecting to external instruments and live captions flickered erratically upon encountering unclosed tags, whereas now connection lights faithfully reflect reality and streamed text renders without a hitch.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed text after an unclosed code block in a list showing as plain text while a reply streams, then turning into code
[VSCode] Fixed MCP server sign-in from the panel opening a broken authorization page when the server URL contains a query string
[VSCode] Fixed the `@browser` banner saying "Browser connected" when no browser with the Claude extension can be reached

title.zh-TW: [Cloud sessions] 排程任務未啟動原因上線，狀態判定與重複執行修復
title.en: [Cloud sessions] Unstarted routine reasons now visible, with status determination and duplicate executions fixed

body.zh-TW: 當你在雲端設定例行排程任務（routine）讓系統自動跑報表或分析時，現在任務的執行履歷更加可靠。在 routine 的管理頁面上，若上次執行未能順利啟動，頂部現在會以醒目橫幅具體說明原因，例如組織已達到同時並行雲端工作階段的上限。以前如果雲端工作階段發生非預期中斷，任務狀態會被誤記為已完成。若在啟動前就遭封存，則會錯誤顯示為已取消。現在這些異常情境均已正確改標記為失敗。同時，當排程任務中途失敗時，系統不會再於一小時或更久之後自作主張從頭重跑，避免重複寄送報告或造成重覆扣款。⟦猶如無人工廠的排程派工看板，以前遇到機台當機卻謊報準時完工，未動工就被撤除的工單也標成取消，中途斷電還會悄悄重做造成原料浪費，現在故障原因一目了然且狀態精確無誤。⟧
body.en: When configuring automated routines in the cloud to run reports or analyses, task execution histories are now more dependable. On the routine management page, if the previous run failed to start properly, a prominent banner at the top now details the specific reason, such as the organization reaching its concurrent cloud session limit. Previously, unexpected interruptions in a cloud session caused the task status to be misrecorded as completed. If a task was archived before starting, it was erroneously displayed as canceled. Now, these edge cases are properly marked as failed. Meanwhile, when a scheduled task fails midway, the system no longer takes it upon itself to restart from scratch an hour or more later, preventing duplicate reports or repeated billing charges. ⟦Operating an automated factory dispatch board reflects this strict accounting: previously, machine crashes were falsely recorded as on-time completions, unstarted work orders pulled from the queue were marked as canceled, and mid-shift power cuts triggered quiet reruns that wasted raw materials, whereas now malfunction causes are crystal clear and status reports remain strictly accurate.⟧

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Added a banner on a routine's page that says why its last run didn't start, such as your organization reaching its limit on concurrent cloud sessions
[Cloud sessions] Fixed routine runs showing as Completed after their cloud session stopped unexpectedly, and as Cancelled when archived before they started, instead of failed
[Cloud sessions] Fixed a scheduled routine run that failed partway being run again from the start an hour or more later, which could repeat work such as posting the same report twice

title.zh-TW: [Cloud sessions] 歷史倒轉與跨裝置同步修復，啟動失敗精確提示原因
title.en: [Cloud sessions] History rewind and cross-device sync fixed, with precise launch failure messages

body.zh-TW: 當你透過瀏覽器進入雲端工作階段與團隊協作時，現在多項操作與介面同步修復得更加平穩。在工作階段中點擊歷史倒轉（Rewind to here）時，以前只有最新一則訊息有效、其餘皆會失敗，現在所有歷史節點都能順暢倒轉；若使用自架執行器則需搭配 Claude Code v2.1.246 或更新版本。當 Pull Request 發生合併衝突時，狀態列不再於 GitHub 重新複查期間短暫跳回準備就緒狀態。當 GitHub 儲存庫被重新命名或移動位置後，差異檢視（diff view）遺漏修改或載入失敗的問題已排除。同時，從另一台裝置傳送的訊息現在會即時出現在已開啟的頁面上，不必再手動重新整理網頁。若工作階段啟動失敗，錯誤訊息改為明確顯示連線中斷（Connection lost）或伺服器錯誤，不再含糊籠統。
body.en: When collaborating with teams in cloud sessions through a browser, multiple operations and interface sync mechanisms are now smoother. When clicking "Rewind to here" inside a session, previously only the latest message worked while all others failed, but now every historical checkpoint rewinds smoothly. Self-hosted runners require Claude Code v2.1.246 or later. When a pull request encounters merge conflicts, the status line no longer briefly flashes back to a ready state during GitHub re-reviews. When a GitHub repository is renamed or moved, issues where the diff view missed modifications or failed to load have been resolved. Meanwhile, messages sent from another device now appear instantly on open pages without requiring a manual refresh. If a session fails to launch, error messages now explicitly indicate "Connection lost" or a server error instead of staying vague.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Fixed "Rewind to here" failing on every message except the newest in cloud sessions; self-hosted runners need Claude Code v2.1.246 or later
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the pull request status bar in cloud sessions flipping a pull request with merge conflicts back to ready while GitHub rechecked it
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the diff view in cloud sessions missing changes or failing to load after the session's GitHub repository was renamed or moved
[Cloud sessions] Fixed an open cloud session sometimes not showing messages sent from another device until you reloaded the page or clicked away and back
[Cloud sessions] Improved the error shown when a cloud session fails to start: it now says "Connection lost" or "Server error" instead of "Something went wrong"

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] Slack 訊息格式與圖片附件修復，私訊不再輕易中斷
title.en: [Claude Tag] Slack message formatting and image attachments fixed, preventing premature direct message drops

body.zh-TW: 當你在 Slack 頻道或私訊中標記 Claude 協助工作時，現在對話格式與傳檔體驗都更加健全。在 Slack 中上傳 HEIC、SVG、TIFF 與 BMP 等格式的圖片，現在會作為工作檔案正常傳遞給 Claude，不再遺失。當 Claude 透過編輯舊訊息回答問題後，標記下方的「is thinking…」提示會正確消除，不再永久殘留。程式碼區塊內附在清單步驟下的網址不再被多餘的角括號包裹，複製指令可直接貼上使用。回覆中的超連結也不會再把後方的粗體、斜體符號或全形標點符號吃進網址內而造成破版。私訊遇到單次 Slack 查詢延遲時，系統現在會先主動重試，不再直接回覆私訊暫不可用並丟棄訊息。在 Slack Enterprise Grid 中，私訊會在你最近開啟 Claude 的那個已連接工作區執行。
body.en: When tagging Claude for assistance in Slack channels or direct messages, conversation formatting and file-sharing experiences are now much more reliable. Images uploaded to Slack in formats such as HEIC, SVG, TIFF, and BMP now pass properly to Claude as working files instead of getting lost. When Claude answers a question by editing an earlier message, the "is thinking…" indicator below the tag clears properly rather than lingering permanently. URLs inside code blocks attached under list steps are no longer wrapped in superfluous angle brackets, allowing copied commands to be pasted directly. Hyperlinks in responses no longer absorb trailing bold markers, italics, or full-width punctuation into the URL and break formatting. When a direct message encounters a delay in a single Slack lookup, the system now proactively retries first, rather than immediately replying that direct messages are unavailable and discarding the request. In Slack Enterprise Grid, direct messages run in whichever connected workspace where you most recently opened Claude.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed "is thinking…" staying up under a mention in a Slack channel or DM after Claude answered it by editing one of its earlier messages
[Claude Tag] Fixed URLs in code blocks under a numbered or bulleted step of Claude's Slack replies being wrapped in angle brackets, which broke copied commands
[Claude Tag] Fixed HEIC, SVG, TIFF and BMP images attached in Slack never reaching Claude; they now arrive as files in its working files, like other file types
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack sometimes answering a direct message with "DMs are temporarily unavailable" and dropping it when a single Slack lookup stalled; it now retries first
[Claude Tag] Fixed direct messages with Claude on a Slack Enterprise Grid ignoring Slack's workspace dropdown; they now run under the connected workspace you last opened Claude in
[Claude Tag] Fixed links in Claude's Slack replies absorbing the closing bold or italic marks, or full-width punctuation, right after them, which broke the link and the formatting

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] 後台管理介面重整為四大分頁，儲存庫與頻道搜尋加速
title.en: [Claude Tag] Admin Interface Reorganized into Four Tabs, Accelerating Repository and Channel Search

body.zh-TW: 管理者在後台調整 Claude 的授權範圍與連線通道時，各項權限現在被整理得井井有條。Claude Tag 後台管理介面重新梳理為四大分頁：Bundles、Connectors、Skills and plugins 以及 Channels，各項權限歸類一目了然。儲存庫搜尋效能明顯提升，現在最多可涵蓋 100 個已連結的 GitHub 帳號，並能搜尋超過 GitHub App 安裝前 5,000 個以外的私人儲存庫。在新增位置功能中，手動輸入或貼上頻道名稱時，系統能立即顯示該頻道，不必再苦等組織的完整頻道清單全數載入。工作區或頻道頁面中的「Add > Domain」選項，只要當前頁面載入完成便立即可用，不必苦等所有頻道載入完畢。⟦彷彿現代化物流倉儲的調度中控台，以前調閱貨架非得等全場庫存盤點完畢才能點選，現在分頁權責分明，輸入貨號隨即顯示對應料架，調度效率明顯提高。⟧
body.en: When administrators adjust Claude authorization scopes and connection channels in the admin console, permissions are now neatly organized. The Claude Tag admin interface has been reorganized into four tabs: Bundles, Connectors, Skills and plugins, and Channels, making permission categories clear at a glance. Repository search performance has noticeably improved, now covering up to 100 connected GitHub accounts and searching private repositories beyond the first 5,000 indexed by GitHub App installations. In the add location feature, manually entering or pasting a channel name immediately displays that channel without waiting for the organization's full channel list to load. The "Add > Domain" option on workspace or channel pages is ready as soon as the current page finishes loading, without waiting for all channels to load. ⟦A modern logistics dispatch console mirrors this upgrade: where staff once waited for a full warehouse inventory count before selecting a shelf, dedicated tabs now surface the matching storage rack immediately upon entering an item code, notably improving dispatch efficiency.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Improved repository search in Claude Tag admin settings to cover up to 100 connected GitHub accounts and find private repositories past the first 5,000 of a GitHub App install
[Claude Tag] Improved Add place in Claude Tag admin settings to list a channel you type or paste right away, instead of only after your organization's full channel list has loaded
[Claude Tag] Improved Add > Domain on a workspace's or channel's page in Claude Tag admin settings to be available once that page loads, not only after every channel has loaded
[Claude Tag] Changed Claude Tag admin settings to organize Claude's access into four tabs: Bundles, Connectors, Skills and plugins, and Channels

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] 頻道管理員角色自動賦權，共用主機連接器獨立顯示
title.en: [Claude Tag] Channel Manager Role Granted Automatic Permissions, Shared-Host Connectors Displayed Independently

body.zh-TW: 當企業針對不同團隊角色嚴格管控 Claude 的使用權限時，管理員身分與外部工具的設定規則現在徹底釐清。在限制角色權限的組織中，新任命的頻道管理員先前可能會失去在 Slack 使用 Claude 的權限；現在管理員角色已自動涵蓋 Claude Tag 的存取授權。組織設定中的角色頁面也進行了整理，為頻道管理員建立的角色現在會集中收納在組織既有角色下方的摺疊區塊中，版面乾淨許多。若多個 MCP 伺服器共用同一個主機位址，後台不再將其錯誤合併為單一連接器，改由每個伺服器各自獨立顯示。當頻道達到每月支出上限時，系統提示不再誤稱頻道管理員能調高額度，而是明確標明組織擁有者並附上用量頁面連結。⟦宛如百貨商場重新整頓專櫃廠商登錄簿，以前店長調派專櫃竟失去收銀權限，共用倉庫的品牌全擠在同一個櫃位，現在主管職務自動開通授權，各品牌獨立列管且額度審批窗口一清二楚。⟧
body.en: When enterprises strictly control Claude usage permissions across different team roles, configuration rules for administrator roles and external tools are now thoroughly clarified. In organizations with restricted role permissions, newly appointed channel managers previously could lose access to Claude in Slack. The manager role now automatically includes access authorization for Claude Tag. The roles page in organization settings has also been tidied up, consolidating roles created for channel managers into a collapsible section beneath existing organization roles for a much cleaner layout. If multiple MCP servers share the same host address, the admin console no longer mistakenly merges them into a single connector, displaying each server independently instead. When a channel reaches its monthly spend cap, the system notice no longer mistakenly claims that channel managers can increase quotas, instead clearly identifying organization owners with a link to the usage page. ⟦Department store administration reorganizes vendor registries in a similar way: floor managers assigned to new counters previously lost register privileges and brands sharing a warehouse were lumped into a single booth, but supervisory roles now activate access automatically, each brand is listed independently, and spending approval contacts are clearly identified.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed new channel managers losing access to Claude in Slack in organizations that restrict Claude Tag by role; the manager role now also grants Claude Tag in Slack
[Claude Tag] Fixed custom connectors whose MCP servers share one host showing as a single connector in Claude Tag admin settings; each server is now its own connector
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack's notice for a channel's monthly spend limit saying a channel manager can raise it; it now names an organization owner and links the usage page
[Claude Tag] Changed the Roles page in organization settings to group the roles created for Claude Tag channel managers in a collapsed section below your organization's own roles

title.zh-TW: [Code Review] 連接 GitHub 後自動恢復設定，重開直接回到選庫畫面
title.en: [Code Review] Setup Automatically Restores After Connecting GitHub, Reopening Directly to Repository Selection

body.zh-TW: 在後台設定程式碼審查（Code Review）流程時，中途跳轉授權不再弄丟原本的進度。以前在設定流程中如果中途離開頁面去連接 GitHub 帳號，返回管理後台時系統無法自動恢復進度，常常需要重新開始；現在這項跳轉中斷問題已經修復，返回後會直接重新開啟在儲存庫挑選畫面，讓你順利接續完成設定。⟦如同填寫出入境申請表時中途跳轉至驗證身分，以前驗證完畢回到原網頁進度全被清空，現在系統會精準保留填寫狀態並自動停在挑選目的地的步驟。⟧
body.en: When configuring Code Review workflows in the admin console, redirecting mid-process for authorization no longer loses your initial progress. Previously, leaving the setup workflow to connect a GitHub account prevented the admin console from automatically restoring progress upon return, often requiring a fresh start. This redirection interruption is now resolved, reopening directly to the repository selection screen upon return so you can smoothly resume setup. ⟦Travelers completing an immigration entry form experience the same relief: previously, redirecting to verify identity wiped all entered details upon return, but the system now faithfully preserves form progress and reopens directly at the destination selection step.⟧

title.zh-TW: 無人值守重試模式支援自訂額度等待上限
title.en: Unattended Retry Mode Adds Configurable Usage Limit Wait Threshold

body.zh-TW: 當你放著 Claude 在背景通宵跑大量任務時，最怕半夜遇到額度限制而卡住空轉。以前開啟無人值守重試模式（`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`，遇到錯誤時自動重試的背景守護機制）後，只要撞上額度上限，即使重設時間遠在好幾個小時後，程式也會一直停在那裡乾等。現在新增了環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS`，只要重設等待時間超出你設定的毫秒上限，就會果斷結束該次請求。⟦像排隊等候叫號，要是櫃檯告示牌寫著下一梯次得等好幾個小時，就先收隊離開而不是傻站在大門口枯等過夜。⟧
body.en: When leaving Claude running extensive tasks in the background overnight, hitting usage limits and idling mid-job is a constant worry. Previously, with unattended retry mode enabled (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`, a background watchdog that automatically retries on errors), hitting a usage limit caused the process to wait indefinitely, even if the reset time was hours away. The new `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS` environment variable decisively terminates the request whenever the reset wait time exceeds your configured millisecond threshold. ⟦Think of taking a queue number: if the counter display says the next batch will take several hours, you pack up and leave rather than waiting around outside all night.⟧

items.original: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) ends a request at a usage limit that resets too far away instead of waiting

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式支援括號跳躍與按鍵狀態切換
title.en: Vim Mode Adds Bracket Matching and Key State Switching

body.zh-TW: 習慣在終端機用快捷鍵飛速跳轉程式碼的 Vim 族群，這版操作手感更貼近原生編輯器。Vim 模式新增了 `%` 移動指令，能跳到配對括號，也能搭配 `d`、`c`、`y` 執行刪除、修改或複製。以前在負載沉重的機器上按 Esc 鍵，有時會卡在 INSERT（插入模式，打字輸入內文的狀態）而無法切換。回答提問輸入框時，自由文字欄位現在支援 NORMAL（一般模式，用來執行移動與指令的瀏覽狀態）。按 Esc 只會先退回一般模式，只有在一般模式下再按 Esc 才會取消，不會直接抹掉你辛苦打好的回答。⟦跟操作傳統手排檔桿一樣，以前離合器踩下偶爾卡在空檔，現在跳檔定位精準俐落，退檔時也不會誤把轉速歸零。⟧
body.en: For Vim users accustomed to navigating code quickly with terminal shortcuts, handling now feels closer to the native editor. Vim mode introduces the `%` motion to jump between matching brackets, which also pairs with `d`, `c`, and `y` for delete, change, or yank operations. Previously, pressing Esc on heavily loaded machines could get stuck in INSERT (the state for typing text) without switching. Free-text fields in prompt inputs now support NORMAL (the navigation state for motions and commands). Pressing Esc now drops back to normal mode first, and only cancels when pressed again in normal mode, preventing your typed answer from being wiped out. ⟦Like shifting a manual transmission, depressing the clutch previously got stuck in neutral at times, but gear changes now lock in cleanly, and downshifting no longer resets engine RPM to zero by mistake.⟧

items.original:
Added the `%` motion to vim mode: jump to the matching bracket, alone or with d/c/y
Fixed vim mode sometimes staying in INSERT after Escape on a slow or busy machine
Fixed Esc discarding a typed AskUserQuestion answer in vim mode: the free-text field now supports vim NORMAL mode, and Esc cancels only from NORMAL

title.zh-TW: OpenTelemetry 追蹤指引與工具決策事件屬性擴充
title.en: OpenTelemetry Tracing Guidance and Expanded Tool Decision Event Attributes

body.zh-TW: 想在企業儀表板掌握 Claude 呼叫工具的原因，觀測日誌現在記錄得更詳盡。在 `claude-api` 技能中加入 OpenTelemetry（跨系統追蹤運作軌跡的開源標準）的設定指引，包含如何使用 `ant` 工具配置追蹤目的地。工具決策事件 `tool_decision` 新增 `classifier_verdict` 與 `permission_mode` 欄位，讓管理員分清自動模式（auto mode，讓 Claude 自主執行的模式）分類器的決策與既有權限規則。啟用 `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` 時，分類器阻擋操作的 `tool_decision` 事件還會以 `classifier_category` 記錄命中的內建規則名稱。⟦就像翻開檢驗報告，以前只標記陰陽性，現在能分清儀器判讀與人工複核，異常時還附上項目名稱。⟧
body.en: Observability logs now record more detail when tracking why Claude invokes tools in enterprise dashboards. Configuration guidance for OpenTelemetry (an open-source standard for tracking execution traces across systems) is now included in the `claude-api` skill, covering how to configure export destinations with the `ant` tool. The `tool_decision` event adds `classifier_verdict` and `permission_mode` fields, helping administrators distinguish classifier decisions in auto mode (the setting allowing Claude to execute autonomously) from existing permission rules. When `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` is enabled, `tool_decision` events where the classifier blocks an action also record the triggered built-in rule name in `classifier_category`. ⟦Picture reviewing a lab report: whereas tests previously only showed positive or negative marks, you can now separate automated instrument readings from manual reviews, complete with specific item names when abnormalities occur.⟧

items.original:
Added OpenTelemetry tracing guidance to the `claude-api` skill, including setting up trace destinations with the `ant` CLI
Added `classifier_verdict` and `permission_mode` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, so auto mode classifier decisions can be told apart from permission rules
Added `classifier_category` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, naming the built-in rule a classifier block matched, when `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1`

title.zh-TW: Mod 擴充模組支援多行輸入與狀態回傳規範
title.en: Mod Extensions Add Multi-Line Input and Standardized Return States

body.zh-TW: 編寫 Mod（擴充 Claude 功能的模組）時，介面與流程控制更精準。`Input` 元件新增 `rows` 屬性，終端機能多行輸入，Enter 送出、Shift+Enter 或反斜線換行。修復在 `claude -p` 或雲端工作階段，首次回覆未完成就呼叫 `$.model.fork` 報錯 `nothing-to-fork`。提問樹狀清單在桌面端、行動端與 VS Code 支援 Markdown 且最多 48 行，終端機維持 12 行。掛鉤（hook，特定事件觸發的小程式）的 `.catch` 改為只在拋出例外或逾時時執行，內部呼叫產生的事件不再轉給自身。設定或取消設定環境變數的方法 `$.env.set`，完成操作時回傳 `{}`；未執行寫入時，回傳附帶原因的 `{ deny }`。
body.en: Interface and flow control become more precise when authoring a Mod (modules that extend Claude's capabilities). The `Input` component adds a `rows` prop for multi-line terminal input, submitting on Enter and inserting newlines on Shift+Enter or backslash. Calling `$.model.fork` before the initial response finishes in `claude -p` or cloud sessions no longer throws `nothing-to-fork`. Prompt tree lists now support Markdown with up to 48 lines across desktop, mobile, and VS Code, while staying at 12 lines in the terminal. The `.catch` handler on a hook (small programs triggered by specific events) now runs only on thrown exceptions or timeouts, and events generated by internal calls are no longer forwarded back to the hook itself. The `$.env.set` method for setting or unsetting environment variables now returns `{}` on successful operations, and `{ deny }` with a reason when writes are skipped.

Improved mods: in VS Code and the desktop and mobile apps, a tree drawn above the question dialog can now hold Markdown and up to 48 rows; the terminal keeps 12 plain rows
Changed a mod hook's `.catch` handler to run only when the hook throws or times out; events raised beneath the hook's own calls now skip that hook without asking its `.catch`
Changed a mod's `$.env.set` to resolve with `{}` once the variable is set or unset, or with `{ deny }` saying why when the write is not made

title.zh-TW: 模型切換流程與長對話自動摘要優化
title.en: Model Switching Flow and Long Conversation Auto-Summarization Improvements

body.zh-TW: 聊到一半想切換到上下文視窗較小的模型，長對話轉移現在處理得更順暢。上下文視窗是模型一次能讀取的最大文字量；若對話太長，會先請原模型精簡摘要，以前未經詢問就扣額度摘要的問題已修復。透過 Anthropic API 使用 `fable` 或 `best` 別名時，若組織尚未開放最新版 Fable，會自動退回前一版重試一次。非 Bedrock 的自訂模型名稱即便包含 `application-inference-profile`，也不會誤跑 `awsAuthRefresh` 耽擱掛鉤。透過閘道器連線時，伺服器回傳不同模型名稱，也不會再反覆用不是你選的模型壓縮對話。⟦猶如搭長途客運轉乘小型接駁車，以前未經同意就收費整理行李，現在先徵得同意，再由原班司機精簡包裹；轉運站也不會搞錯車號讓你反覆轉乘。⟧
body.en: Switching mid-conversation to a model with a smaller context window is now much smoother when transferring long dialogs. A context window represents the maximum text volume a model can read at once. When conversations run too long, the original model is asked to summarize them first, resolving an issue where quota was deducted for summarization without asking. When using `fable` or `best` aliases through the Anthropic API, organizations without access to the latest Fable release will automatically fall back to the prior version and retry once. Non-Bedrock custom model names that include `application-inference-profile` no longer mistakenly run `awsAuthRefresh` and delay hooks. When connecting through a gateway, differing model names returned by the server will no longer cause repeated conversation compression using an unselected model. ⟦A passenger transfers from a long-haul coach to a compact shuttle: luggage was previously repacked for an unapproved fee, but permission is now requested first while the original driver streamlines the cargo, and the transit station avoids mixing up fleet numbers that forced endless re-transfers.⟧

Fixed a case where switching to a model with a smaller context window could spend usage credits on a summary by the previous model without asking first
Fixed conversations being compacted over and over, on a model you didn't pick, behind an LLM gateway whose responses name a different model than the one requested
Improved switching to a model with a smaller context window: a conversation too long for the new model is now summarized by the previous model first

title.zh-TW: 技能參數填入效能與外掛權限來源顯示修復
title.en: Skill Parameter Hydration Performance and Plugin Permission Attribution Fixes

body.zh-TW: 在專案中安裝大量自訂技能或外掛工具時，指令呼叫與權限確認現在更俐落透明。過去技能（擴充特定領域知識與指令的手冊）與命令若包含過多或過長的參數名稱，呼叫時會卡頓數秒。現在限制僅填入前 64 個名稱且每個最多 64 個字元。修復了技能、命令與掛鉤在填入大量佔位符時耗用大量記憶體的問題。修復 `/rewind` 回退對話後技能清單在模型中消失的問題，並更正了 `/claude-api` 技能誤稱 AWS 上 Claude 平台不支援 CMEK 外部金鑰端點的說明。外掛或技能掛鉤若觸發 `ask` 詢問決策，彈出的權限確認提示現在會明確標示該掛鉤來自哪一個外掛或技能。⟦類似翻閱零件庫存的規格清冊，以前填寫欄位太多會整疊卡在夾板上動彈不得，現在規格索引限制在精簡欄位內，調用工具時也清楚貼上所屬工具箱的產權標籤。⟧
body.en: Invoking commands and confirming permissions is now cleaner and more transparent when projects install numerous custom skills or plugins. Previously, skills (playbooks expanding domain knowledge and commands) and commands with too many or excessively long parameter names stuttered for seconds during invocation. Hydration is now limited to the first 64 names with a maximum of 64 characters each. An issue where skills, commands, and hooks consumed excessive memory while hydrating numerous placeholders has been resolved. The skill catalog no longer vanishes from the model after running `/rewind` to roll back conversations, and documentation in `/claude-api` mistakenly claiming the Claude platform on AWS lacks CMEK external key endpoint support has been corrected. When a plugin or skill hook triggers an `ask` prompt for decisions, the confirmation dialog now clearly labels which plugin or skill originated the hook. ⟦Imagine consulting a parts inventory ledger: having too many entry fields previously jammed the entire clipboard, but specification indexes are now capped to compact entries, and retrieved tools clearly display ownership labels for their parent toolbox.⟧
